subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Atribuir significado a aspectos não linguísticos (paralinguísticos) observados na fala, como direção do olhar, riso, gestos, movimentos da cabeça (de concordância ou discordância), expressão corporal, tom de voz.

components.description_pt: Identificar elementos paralinguísticos na comunicação oral, como gestos e linguagem corporal
components.description_en: Identify paralinguistic elements in oral communication, such as gestures, gaze, and body language

components.description_pt: Interpretar significado transmitido pelo tom de voz em interações faladas
components.description_en: Interpret meaning conveyed by tone of voice in spoken interactions
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the impact of specific word choices on the meaning and tone of a narrative

components.description_pt: Explicar como sinais paralinguísticos como riso contribuem para o significado na fala
components.description_en: Explain how paralinguistic cues such as laughter or head movements contribute to meaning in speech
components.cc_component_description: Explain how visual or multimedia elements contribute to the meaning of a literary text

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will interpret language arts narratives by
* Identifying a theme __or central idea that develops over the course of a text__
* Analyzing how character attributes and actions develop __in relation to events or dialogue__
* __Evaluating impact of specific word choices about meaning and tone__
Analyze how visual and multimedia elements contribute to the meaning, tone, or beauty of a text (e.g., graphic novel, multimedia presentation of fiction, folktale, myth, poem).
